text:
## Common Mistakes (Don't Make These!)  
❌ **Mistake 1:** Ignoring customer data access request
✅ **Correct:** Forward to DPO within 24 hours  
❌ **Mistake 2:** Sharing customer data with third party without consent
✅ **Correct:** Only share with explicit permission or legal requirement  
❌ **Mistake 3:** Keeping customer data longer than necessary
✅ **Correct:** Delete/archive when retention period expires  
❌ **Mistake 4:** Discussing customer data in public (overhearing customers)
✅ **Correct:** Have sensitive conversations in private area

raw_entities.name: Customer Data Access Request Handling
raw_entities.description: Staff must forward customer data access requests to the Data Protection Officer (DPO) within 24 hours of receipt. This is a mandatory compliance duty under data protection regulations.

raw_entities.name: Third-Party Data Sharing Consent Requirement
raw_entities.description: Staff must obtain explicit customer permission before sharing customer data with any third party, or ensure a legal requirement exists to justify the disclosure.
context: Sharing customer data with third party without consent
Only share with explicit permission or legal requirement

raw_entities.name: Customer Data Retention Period Compliance
raw_entities.description: Staff must delete or archive customer data once the applicable retention period has expired. Keeping data longer than necessary violates data protection obligations.
context: Keeping customer data longer than necessary

raw_entities.name: Confidential Customer Data Privacy in Public Spaces
raw_entities.description: Staff must conduct sensitive conversations involving customer data in private areas to prevent unauthorized disclosure or overhearing by other customers or members of the public.
context: Discussing customer data in public (overhearing customers)
Have sensitive conversations in private area
